title: Articles
note: Authoring law: a/an = first time / one job·thing. the = same thing again (a X already in the gap line) OR only-one (situational). Never bare CZ alone as the only cue for the. · names from the GLUE name pool · flags 2026-07-25: doctor cue; hour accepts; uni; bag rewrite; here/there · classfix B/D/E-2026-07-25 · 2026-08-06 re-lexified onto pool-legal vocabulary (see BUILD-DIGEST cloud run 2); only remaining out-of-pool word is 'hour', kept because it is the silent-h example

items.cz: Mám telefon. (jedna věc — poprvé)
items.explanation: One thing, first time → a (not the yet).

items.cz: Potřebuju tašku. (jedna taška — poprvé)
items.explanation: One thing, first time → a (not the yet).

items.cz: Potřebuju klidný pokoj. (a + přídavné jméno + podstatné jméno)
items.explanation: a goes before the whole group: a + adjective + noun.
items.explanation_cz: a stojí před celou skupinou: a + přídavné jméno + podstatné jméno.

items.cz: Ona má kolo. (jedna věc — poprvé)
items.explanation: One thing, first time → a (not the yet).

items.en: There is a lamp in my bedroom.
items.cz: V mé ložnici je lampa. (poprvé zmíněná věc → a)
items.gap: There is ____ lamp in my bedroom.
accepts: There is a lamp in my bedroom.
There's a lamp in my bedroom.
items.explanation: First mention of one thing → a.
items.explanation_cz: První zmínka o jedné věci → a.

items.cz: Ona je učitelka. (povolání → a/an + povolání; ne the)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: On je doktor. (povolání → a/an + povolání; ne the — není to „ten konkrétní“ doktor)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: Petr je student. (povolání/role; ne the)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: On je policista. (povolání → a; ne the)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.en: I eat an apple for lunch.
items.cz: K obědu jím jablko. (jedno · samohláska → an)
accepts: I eat an apple for lunch.
items.explanation: Next word starts with a vowel sound → an.

items.cz: Ona má staré auto. (jedno · samohláska old → an)
items.explanation: Listen to the next word, not the noun: an old car.
items.explanation_cz: Rozhoduje další slovo, ne podstatné jméno: an old car.

items.cz: Máme hodinu. (jedna hodina · němé h → an)
items.explanation: Hour starts with a vowel sound (silent h) → an hour.

items.cz: On pracuje v kanceláři. (samohláska → an)
items.explanation: Next word starts with a vowel sound → an.

items.en: I eat an egg for breakfast.
items.cz: K snídani jím vejce. (jedno · samohláska → an)
accepts: I eat an egg for breakfast.
items.explanation: Next word starts with a vowel sound → an.

items.cz: Tohle je univerzita. (zvuk yu- → a university, ne an; první zmínka, ne the)
items.explanation: University starts with a /j/ sound ("you") → a, not an.

items.en: I have a book. The book is on the table.
items.cz: Mám knihu. Ta kniha je na stole.
items.gap: I have a book. ____ book is on the table.
accepts: I have a book. The book is on the table.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: This is a school. The school is modern.
items.cz: Tohle je škola. Ta škola je moderní.
items.gap: This is a school. ____ school is modern.
accepts: This is a school. The school is modern.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: I have a map. The map is in my bag.
items.cz: Mám mapu. Ta mapa je v mé tašce.
items.gap: I have a map. ____ map is in my bag.
accepts: I have a map. The map is in my bag.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: There is a window. Open the window, please.
items.cz: Je tu okno. Otevři to okno, prosím.
items.gap: There is a window. Open ____ window, please.
accepts: There is a window. Open the window, please.
There is a window. Open the window please.
There's a window. Open the window, please.
Here is a window. Open the window, please.
Here's a window. Open the window, please.
items.explanation: We already said a window. Now we know which one → the.

items.en: He has a bike. The bike is in the garden.
items.cz: On má kolo. To kolo je na zahradě.
items.gap: He has a bike. ____ bike is in the garden.
accepts: He has a bike. The bike is in the garden.
He's got a bike. The bike is in the garden.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: I have a key. The key is on the desk.
items.cz: Mám klíč. Ten klíč je na stole.
items.gap: I have a key. ____ key is on the desk.
accepts: I have a key. The key is on the desk.
I've got a key. The key is on the desk.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: There is a car. The car is near the house.
items.cz: Je tu auto. To auto je blízko domu.
items.gap: There is a car. ____ car is near the house.
accepts: There is a car. The car is near the house.
There's a car. The car is near the house.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: There is only one bathroom here. The bathroom is upstairs.
items.cz: Je tu jen jedna koupelna. Ta koupelna je nahoře.
items.gap: There is only one bathroom here. ____ bathroom is upstairs.
accepts: There is only one bathroom here. The bathroom is upstairs.
There's only one bathroom here. The bathroom is upstairs.
items.explanation: Only one in the situation — we both know which → the.
items.explanation_cz: Jen jedna v dané situaci → the.

items.en: There is only one station in this village. The station is near the park.
items.cz: V téhle vesnici je jen jedno nádraží. To nádraží je blízko parku.
items.gap: There is only one station in this village. ____ station is near the park.
accepts: There is only one station in this village. The station is near the park.
There's only one station in this village. The station is near the park.
items.explanation: Only one in the situation — we both know which → the.
items.explanation_cz: Jen jedno v dané situaci → the.

items.cz: Mám rád psy. (množné číslo obecně — bez členu)
items.explanation: Plural in general → no article. Not a dogs / the dogs (unless specific dogs).

items.cz: Ona má knihy. (množné číslo — bez členu)
items.explanation: Plural in general → no article.

items.cz: Potřebujeme židle. (množné číslo — bez členu)
items.explanation: Plural in general → no article.

items.cz: Oni mají telefony. (množné číslo — bez členu)
items.explanation: Plural in general → no article.

items.cz: Piju vodu. (nepočitatelné — bez a/an)
items.explanation: Uncountable (water, milk, music…) → usually no a/an.

items.cz: Ona má ráda hudbu. (nepočitatelné — bez a/an)
items.explanation: Uncountable (water, milk, music…) → usually no a/an.

items.cz: On potřebuje pomoc. (nepočitatelné — bez a/an)
items.explanation: Uncountable abstract words (help, information…) → usually no a/an.

items.cz: Jíme rýži. (nepočitatelné — bez a/an)
items.explanation: Uncountable (water, rice, music…) → usually no a/an.

cards.title: Articles · the idea
cards.body: Small words before a noun. In Czech you often say nothing — in English you usually choose **a / an**, **the**, or **nothing**.
points: Missing a/an/the before **one** person or thing is a very common error
First goal: choose the right option — use the map on the next card

cards.title: a, an, the — or nothing?
cards.body: One question first. Then the kind of noun.
points: **a / an** = one singular countable (first time / one of many)
**no article** = plurals in general, or uncountables (water, music…)

cards.title: a or an?
points: Listen to the **sound**, not only the letter
**a** + consonant sound: a bag, a teacher, a university (yoo-)
**an** + vowel sound: an apple, an office, an hour (silent h)

rows: a phone · a student · a quiet room
an apple · an egg · an hour

cards.title: When: the (and a → the)
points: You said it before (**a** book → **the** book)
Only one in the situation (open **the** window · **the** bathroom here)

cards.title: Common A1 mistakes
points: Do not leave the noun empty when you mean **one** person or thing

cards.title: Quick check
cards.body: One of many (first time) → a/an. We know which → the. Plurals / uncountables often → nothing.
points: I have a book. ___ book is on the table. → **The**
Harder zero patterns (school, hospital, countries…) come later
